text:
asha: quick sync — want to align on post-launch plan for the 'midwave' consolidation. customers have reported ~3 regressions and a handful of enhancement asks. proposing we build a small bug heatmap and a gating rubric so enhancements don't block critical fixes. thoughts?

ben: can you drop the signal we have? crash rates, customer impact, repro steps? without that we can't prioritize accurately.

jasmine: customer quote from ACME: 'import fails for CSVs >20MB, blocks our onboarding' — ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.example/RL-1234. they're enterprise and test infra-heavy.

priya: quick triage rubric suggestion (very rough):
```
# score = customers_affected * severity_weight + sla_penalty
# severity_weight: 10 (blocker), 5 (major), 1 (minor)
# sla_penalty: 100 if customer is enterprise + active contract
if score > 1000 -> P0
elif score > 100 -> P1
else -> P2
```
Use this to feed the heatmap (x axis = severity, y axis = # customers).

tom: support numbers: 23 tickets in last 48h, 12 dupes, 4 clearly high-severity (import crash, streaming timeout, auth error, attribution mismatch).

ben: proposal:
- P0 (regressions breaking core flows like import/streaming) -> immediate hotfix; canary + rollback plan, target 24–48h.
- P1 -> fast follow (next-day cadence) if fix < 8 dev-hours, otherwise schedule into next micro-release.
- P2/enhancements -> grooming bucket for next wave; require acceptance criteria + owner.

asha: can we agree to this gating? also, for enhancements requested by enterprise customers, add a 'commercial impact' flag so sales/CS can lobby for prioritization.

jasmine: yes, add commercial impact. ACME is flagged high and would consider a paid backport.

priya: UX mitigation idea for import bug: add inline warning + docs showing workaround (split files), buys time while eng works on the deeper fix.

ben: agree. quick wins: docs + UI banner (priya), triage + repro (tom), hotfix branch (ben). assign owners?

asha: assigning:
- triage & repro: tom (support)
- hotfix PR: ben (eng)
- UX banner + docs: priya (design)
- customer comms & commercial ask: jasmine (CS)
- heatmap + prioritization calc: asha (PM)

deploy-bot: Canary build queued: build/rl-hotfix-1768 -> https://ci.redwood.example/build/rl-hotfix-1768 :rocket:

jasmine: pinging legal for enterprise backport T&Cs, will update thread.

ben: rough rollout plan if hotfix passes canary: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (monitor errors + 5m SLO). rollback on new error spike >2x baseline.

priya: minor note — if we show a docs workaround, mention performance caveats so customers don't hit more errors.

asha: ok next steps: tom to confirm repro & list affected customers by EOD, ben to open hotfix branch and share PR link, priya to draft banner copy, jasmine to own comms. I'll assemble heatmap and run a 15-min sync tomorrow AM to lock scope. :thumbsup:

ben: +1
priya: +1

tom: on it

jasmine: sending update to ACME after I hear back from legal

asha: thanks everyone — landing doc here for reference: https://docs.redwood.example/postlaunch/midwave-heatmap (draft).
